name: report-mcp
description: One-way agent -> human reporting MCP: progress, status, logs and structured results, persisted as JSONL and streamed to a local web panel.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node panel/build.mjs && node scripts/build-demo.mjs && node scripts/build-worker-assets.mjs
scripts.worker:dev: npm run build && wrangler dev --config worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.worker:deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy --config worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.docs:dev: npm run docs:stage && npm --prefix docs run dev
scripts.docs:build: npm run docs:stage && npm --prefix docs run build
